title: Open day on 18 January: come and sit in on a class
excerpt: The doors are open from ten until two. Try a twenty-minute lesson in any subject, meet the people who teach it and see the rooms.
content:
On Saturday 18 January the doors are open from ten until two. You can try a twenty-minute lesson in any subject, meet the people who teach it and see the rooms you would be learning in.

What happens on the day

  • Short lessons every half hour, in all six subjects
  • Instructors and former students in the café to answer questions
  • Advice on fees, instalments and employer funding

Do I need to book?

No. Come when it suits you and stay as long as you like. If you already know which course you want, the admissions page explains how to apply.
